WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(brokrepstat, 'NULL') as status,
    AVG(modelconf) as avg_modelconf
  FROM compliancecase
  WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(brokrepstat, 'NULL')
),
baseline_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) as baseline_value
  FROM status_averages
),
above_baseline AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.status,
    sa.avg_modelconf,
    sa.avg_modelconf - bv.baseline_value as diff,
    bv.baseline_value
  FROM status_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN baseline_val bv
  WHERE bv.baseline_value IS NOT NULL
    AND sa.avg_modelconf > bv.baseline_value
),
qualifying_mean_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) as qualifying_mean
  FROM above_baseline
)
SELECT 
  ab.status,
  ab.avg_modelconf,
  ab.diff,
  ab.avg_modelconf / qmv.qualifying_mean as ratio
FROM above_baseline ab
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean_val qmv
WHERE qmv.qualifying_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ab.status

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in brokrepstat are grouped together and represented as the string 'NULL' in output, following the requirement to treat 'cases with no status as their own group'.
